mira wong: Flipped 'strand-fusion' on canary GPUs at 08:30 PT. Quick snapshot: p50 -11%, p95 -16%, token cost per 1M tokens down ~26% on our mixed-gen suite (gpt-medium). Posting short notes + links.

eliot park: woo! any tail or error blips?

mira wong: small transient uptick in 502s (0.18%) for streaming sessions during first 7m due to allocator handoff race. Deployed a serialized handoff patch at 08:38 and errors returned to baseline by 08:45. No customer impact.

devops-bot: Canary metrics (08:50 PT): p50 68ms -> 60ms, p95 240ms -> 202ms, TokenCost/1M $0.79 -> $0.58. Events: strand_fusion=enabled @2061234567, patch=@2061234590. https://redwood-infra/canary/2061234567

sam greene: Plan for Dedicated? opt-in or auto-rollout?

mira wong: Opt-in for 72h. Toggle per-pool: `rctl feature enable strand_fusion --pool=dedicated-us-west --duration=72h`. Recommend 2% -> 10% ramp with auto-fallback on >0.5% error or >12% p95 uplift. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/runtime/strand-fusion

nora h: i'll add a nightly perf-eval to watch streaming tails and sparse-attn families. we'll gate promotions on those checks.

mira wong: thanks team. I'll post the canary artifact + rollout playbook in #eng-runtime by EOD and schedule a short retro for 2026-04-06 09:00 PT.
